definitions.explanation: The mental faculty by which one decides on actions. Determination to do something.

⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意志|いし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧。
{意志|いし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧。

notes:
{意志|いし} refers to a person's will, determination, or resolve — the inner drive to act or achieve something. It emphasizes firmness of purpose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意志|いし}が{強|つよ}い: strong-willed
- {意志|いし}が{弱|よわ}い: weak-willed
- {意志|いし}を{持|も}つ: to have a will/determination
- {自分|じぶん}の{意志|いし}で: of one's own will
- {意志|いし}を{貫|つらぬ}く: to carry through one's will
- {意志|いし}{表示|ひょうじ}: declaration of intent

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {意志|いし} ({志|こころざし}): will, volition — emphasizes determination and resolve
- {意思|いし} ({思|おも}い): intention, mind — emphasizes what one thinks or intends
- Example: {意志|いし}が{強|つよ}い (strong-willed) vs. {意思|いし}{表示|ひょうじ} (expression of intent)

In practice, {意志|いし} focuses on firmness and character, while {意思|いし} focuses on one's wishes or intentions in a specific situation.
